text.autoconfig.aun.title: A-U-N Settings
text.autoconfig.aun.option.reachBehind.@: Right-click an item frame to open the chest (or other container) behind it. Crouch and click to rotate the item.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.reachBehindSi: Right-click a wall sign to open the chest (or other container) behind it. Crouch and click to edit the sign.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.cutThrough.@T: With a sword, axe, mace or trident you can hit mobs standing behind tall grass and other plants.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.dismountOnCli: Right-click any mob sitting in a boat or minecart to make it get out onto the closest solid ground.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.armorStandSwa: Crouch and right-click an armor stand to swap your armor with it, or put your armor on it.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.doubleDoors.@: Opening or closing one door of a double door also moves the other one.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.simpleHarvest: Right-click a grown crop to harvest and replant it. Hoes harvest bigger areas: gold/iron/copper 2x2, diamond plus shape, netherite 3x3.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.autoPickup.@T: Items from blocks you mine go straight into your inventory.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.fastLeafDecay: After you cut a tree down its leaves vanish quickly. Only naturally grown leaves are affected, never leaves placed by players.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.horseInfo.@To: Right-click a horse, donkey or mule to see its speed (blocks per second) and jump height (blocks) above your hotbar.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.closeCall.@To: A tool with only 1 use left is moved from your hotbar into your inventory so it cannot break while you mine.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.autoToolSwitc: When you start mining a block, your hotbar jumps to the tool that mines it fastest.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.bookScroll.@T: Turn the pages of a book or Book and Quill with the mouse wheel.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.fullbright.@T: Allows the Fullbright key (default H, change it in the controls menu) to toggle full brightness.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.netherCalc.@T: Type /nethercalc in chat to calculate the matching Nether or Overworld portal coordinates rounded to 0.5.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.stackRefill.@: Automatically replaces a consumed stack in your hand with a matching stack from your inventory.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.autoTotem.@To: Automatically equips a new Totem of Undying from your inventory right after one pops.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.autoClimbLadd: On a ladder, look up to climb up automatically, look straight to hold still, and look down to climb down.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.noAccidentalL: Axes only strip logs, stems and bamboo when you are crouching (Shift + Right-click).
text.autoconfig.aun.option.zoom.@Tooltip: Hold the Zoom key (default C, changeable in Controls) to zoom in.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.betterF1.@Too: Press F1 once to hide only the HUD while keeping your hand visible; press F1 again to hide both HUD and hand.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.disableNarrat: Keeps the vanilla narrator turned off.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.disableAdvanc: Prevents the Advancements keybind from opening the advancements screen.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.facingPlaceme: Hold the 'Place Facing Into Block' key (or 'Place Facing Away' / Ctrl) to orient directional blocks relative to the clicked block face.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.accurateBlock: Makes placing blocks smooth and reliable while holding right-click.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.ctrlDropAllSa: In an inventory, hold Control and press Drop (Q) on a slot to drop all stacks of that same item at once.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.bundleFix.@To: Expands the bundle tooltip grid so you can see all items inside without any hidden slots.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.borderlessFul: Uses borderless fullscreen so clicking on a second monitor does not minimize Minecraft.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.noResourcePac: Removes the compatibility confirmation popup when enabling resource packs from older or newer versions.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.deletedWorldP: Moves deleted worlds into saves/_deleted_worlds_bin instead of permanently deleting them.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.clearWater.@T: Removes underwater fog for clear vision.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.clearLava.@To: Removes under-lava fog so you can see clearly in lava.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.clearPowderSn: Removes the thick fog when inside powdered snow.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.hideOwnPartic: Hides your own potion effect particles while in first-person view.
Hides your own potion effect particles while in third-person view.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.moreChatHisto: Increases the maximum chat history from 100 messages to 1000 messages.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.enchantmentDe: Shows what each enchantment does directly beneath its name on item tooltips.
key.aun.face_into: Place Block Facing Into Clicked Face
key.aun.face_away: Place Block Facing Away From Clicked Face
text.autoconfig.aun.option.mobGriefing.a: Endermen can no longer pick up or place blocks.
Creeper explosions still damage entities but never break blocks.
Ghast fireballs no longer destroy blocks or start fires.
Blaze fireballs no longer ignite blocks.
Ravagers no longer break leaves or crops.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.hideBeaconBea: ON: tinted glass above a beacon hides the beam and the beacon keeps giving effects. OFF: tinted glass no longer affects the beacon, so the beam stays visible and effects keep working.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.safeLightning: Lightning keeps its sound and particles but never starts fires.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.instaMineGlas: Netherite pickaxe with Efficiency V instantly breaks any glass block or pane.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.instaMineDeep: Netherite pickaxe with Efficiency V plus Haste II instantly breaks deepslate and its variants.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.speedHappyGha: A Happy Ghast with the Speed effect flies faster, like a player with Speed runs faster.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.happyGhastBoo: Type a number: 100 = default boost, 150 = 1.5 times the default, 200 = double, 0 = no boost. Only works while the option above is ON.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.noBatSpawning: Wild bats are removed when they appear. Named bats are left alone.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.anvilNoTooExp: Removes the 40-level limit of the anvil.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.playerDropsNe: Items you drop (or your items when you die) do not disappear after 5 minutes, but they are removed when you leave the world. Other items still despawn normally.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.stackingXp.@T: Merges nearby XP orbs into larger single orbs to improve performance.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.infiniteVilla: Villager trades never lock out or go out of stock.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.noZombieDoorB: Prevents zombies from breaking down doors.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.enchantThroug: Leaves, flowers, vines, grass and lichen between bookshelves and the enchanting table no longer block enchanting levels.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.noCropTrample: Players wearing Feather Falling boots will never trample farmland.
Mobs can no longer trample farmland.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.trueVanillaGa: Locks your gamemode in the world so it cannot be changed while enabled.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.piglinPortalF: Nether portals no longer spawn zombified piglins.
Water cannot wash away redstone wire, torches, repeaters or comparators; it flows around them.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.enderPearlFix: Fixes MC-306936: ender pearls that were removed no longer come back when you log in.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.noAnimalTempt: Animals immediately follow you again when switching back to their breeding item without the 5-second delay.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.rocketElytraF: Firework rockets no longer slow you down when you are already flying faster than normal rocket speed.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.stackedMineca: Minecarts occupying the same space no longer self-boost infinitely without powered rails.
gamerule.aun.macenerfdmgplayer.descripti: A mace smash from a player always deals exactly 1 HP to another player.
